note: Pre-registered before any stop-loss result was computed. Never edit after a run; supersede with bl053_criteria_addendum_N.json naming what it replaces.

strategies.configs_source: data/search/round7_A results, as listed in docs/top-strategies-2026-10-08.md
strategies.configs_phases: every rebalance phase, equal capital tranches, equity averaged (method._score_group)
strategies.ensemble: search_spaces/bl010_phase6_frozen.json: four sleeves at their frozen offsets, equal capital reset each April (choose.ensemble_curve)

grid.cells: every combination with at least one stop on: 15 threshold pairs x 2 proceeds = 30 cells, each run at both delays; the baseline is both stops off

fill_timing: The engine fills Broad trades only at a Friday close. stop_delay 0 sells at the close the fall is seen on (optimistic: the order cannot be placed before Monday). stop_delay 1 sells at the next Friday close (pessimistic). A Monday-open fill lies between them in time, so a cell must pass at BOTH delays.

metrics.max_drawdown: deepest peak-to-trough fall of the weekly curve

pass_rule_per_cell.a_risk: Ulcer index AND max drawdown both lower (shallower) than the baseline's in at least 7 of the 11 strategies
pass_rule_per_cell.b_return: median over the 11 strategies of (cell CAGR - baseline CAGR) >= -0.02
pass_rule_per_cell.c_bad_years: median over the 11 strategies of third-worst-FY excess >= the baseline's median
pass_rule_per_cell.both_delays: a cell passes only if a, b and c all hold at stop_delay 0 AND at stop_delay 1

verdict.helps: at least 10 of the 30 cells pass
verdict.inconclusive: 1 to 9 cells pass: they are named, not adopted

monday_open_check: report only, not part of the verdict: the audit replay (audit/studies.monday_open) of the ensemble's four sleeves, baseline and each passing cell at stop_delay 0, repriced at the next trading day's open
hold_out: 2012-2016 stays sealed (BL-010 addendum 5); nothing after 2026-10-02 is used
will_not_run: other thresholds or a finer grid
a re-buy cool-down after a stop
